coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8707009 (3,868 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 111 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8707009 and 110 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 46264112, 325 Berry St)); 95% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 95% of the lot.

changes.text: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8707009 lists the address 325 Berry St. Added as the record's address.
Park Terrace now uses its Assessor lot lines.
Park Terrace now shows its construction permit as completed on Oct 10, 2007.

The map notes gave 110 units and a 2007 build with only an OSM way cited, and said the developer was not confirmed. A dated note now cites SocketSite (May 2006: 110 units, seven stories, developers Opus West and Phoenix Property Company) and the DataSF Assessor roll (year built 2007). The 2006 and 2007 milestones cite those pages instead of a bare domain and an uncheckable listing, and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III.

Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm on 2026-09-27; fuller details shown in this record's map notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.
